description:
Represents Microsoft Defender for Identity sensors that can be migrated to the unified security portal.

TIP: Gets a specific sensor migration job by ID. Returns the full migration trace: source/target versions, current step, errors (if status=failed), per-step timestamps. Use to investigate why a specific migration is stuck or failed. Beta-only endpoint.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-sensor-migration
